changelog:
Initial release of Conversation Summarizer.

- Summarizes long conversations, chat logs, and transcripts into structured summaries.
- Extracts topics, key decisions, action items (with owners and deadlines), and open questions.
- Captures notable quotes, tracks sentiment and consensus, and segments discussion topics.
- Optimized output formats for meeting notes, Slack/Discord threads, support tickets, and emails.
- Supports multiple summary detail levels (executive, standard, detailed).
- Outputs in Markdown, Slack message, email, JIRA/Linear ticket, and calendar formats.
